questions.locate_now: The ball has been made invisible in this frame, which is frozen 4 seconds into the play. Based on player positions, body orientation, and motion, where is the ball RIGHT NOW? Answer with a grid cell: col=<0-5> row=<0-3>, where col 0 is the far left of the pitch and col 5 is the far right, row 0 is the top of the frame and row 3 is the bottom.
questions.predict_next: Now predict one second further: where will the ball be at the 5-second mark (1 second after this frame)? Answer with the same grid format: col=<0-5> row=<0-3>.
